subject.title: Traveling Politician Project (Completed) & Medicaid Forecasting Project (Started) & MMIS AI Workflow Setup
details: Traveling Politician Project (https://github.com/RossJiao/traveling-politician-project): Implemented greedy algorithm to find route from Des Moines, Iowa to Washington, DC visiting all 50 state capitals. Used Haversine formula for distance calculation. Handled Alaska and Hawaii as special cases at the end of route. Total route distance: 22,539 miles. Code and route output pushed to GitHub.

Medicaid Enrollment and Expenditure Forecasting Project (Started): Reviewed project objective: forecast annual Medicaid enrollments and expenditures nationwide and state-specific for the next 10 years. Read EMRTS blog post on Medicaid enrollment reflections. Identified data sources (CMS, KFF) and began researching available datasets.

MMIS AI - Electronic Claim Entry & Submission Portal: Project restructured: combined X12 generation and transmission groups into single Back End team. Reviewed GitHub collaboration workflow guide. Accessed shared repository: https://github.com/ShawnLeeTech/emr-claim-entry-portal. Attended Le's X12 837P introduction session - learned about ISA/IEA envelope structure and Loops (1000, 2000, 2300). Reviewed Chao's database schema updates (new insurance policy and coverage tables).

notes: Traveling Politician uses greedy approximation; 2-opt optimization planned but not yet implemented.
Medicaid project currently in data discovery phase.
MMIS AI now uses GitHub PR workflow (branch -> commit -> push -> pull request -> review).
